g.text: A model-generated answer is a proposal. Python validates structure, provenance and selected financial / temporal consistency before accepting it.
Cited IDs must have been read.
Reject changed or joined source text.
Named metric must match row label.
Decimal arithmetic: thousands / millions / billions and rounding.
Bind comparative numeric columns to explicit year / date headings.
A rounded disclosure cannot refute overlapping finer precision.
Interim figures do not establish later full-year actuals.
Global headcount alone cannot disprove a smaller regional count.
Return the concrete error to the Executor, not a silent relabel.
Numeric feedback includes the resolved source value and column.
The model can read more evidence or submit a corrected candidate.
Retry only while budget remains; missing disclosure is not falsehood.
Exact quotation proves provenance, not every semantic conclusion.
Filings confirm the claim for its
Filings refute the same scoped claim.
Cite both filings. A correctly dated
Available filings do not resolve it.
Keep context / search trail; do not
Operational status is separate: complete = validated submission; incomplete = failure / budget stop. An incomplete NEI fallback is never scored as a correct completed answer.
